prompts.name: 01-home
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE striking new visual concept IMAGE for the GoodChat official website, a Chinese online customer-service SaaS. The user says the previous design still does not feel technological and asks for a completely different version; colors are free to change. Design direction: SILVER WHITE + COBALT BLUE, a refined futuristic technology product brand.
Target: a coherent desktop landing page, 1440px wide and approximately 1800px tall. Focus on a memorable first fold plus two concise supporting sections and footer. Exact clear Simplified Chinese, readable 14–16px body UI type and strong 72–88px headline.
Input image role: attached previous green proposal is product context and a REJECTED VISUAL REFERENCE ONLY. DO NOT merely recolor it. DO NOT reuse its left-headline/right-full-chat-dashboard, three stacked source cards, thin green routing diagram, repeated three-column feature band, or giant outlined numeral2. Change composition, type hierarchy, materials, product framing and visual identity.
Hard constraints: LIGHT theme, white/silver main surfaces, only small saturated blue accents; no large dark regions or dark navy panels. No green anywhere. No purple, no blue-purple gradients, no rainbow or full-page gradient wash. No overlaid commentary or option labels. No fake customer logos, invented awards or statistics. Basic service is free with2 agent seats. AI feature is PAGE DESIGN, not autonomous AI customer service. Native clients are future, not currently shipped.
New art direction:
- A contemporary technology brand with precise spacing, architectural type, technical editorial composition and a memorable custom 3D communication sculpture.
- Cool white #FFFFFF, metallic silver #E9EDF5, very pale ice #F5F8FF, deep readable ink #111A2C, crisp cobalt #2454F5, tiny cyan highlights only in realistic material reflection.
- Realistic premium 3D rendered silver-and-clear-glass intertwined conversation-loop sculpture as the hero centerpiece, with a restrained cobalt inner edge. This is a metaphor for connected conversations, not a robot or AI brain. Small thin blue signal strokes run through it toward a few real readable conversation fragments. Physical believable material, deliberate studio lighting, subtle shadow, not cheap chunky floating emoji art.
- Use gridlines / coordinate ticks / tiny monospace section identifiers very sparingly. Do NOT blanket the whole background with a grid. Typography and the sculpture do the work.
PAGE COMPOSITION:
1. Top72px white navigation. Blue precision conversation monogram with BLACK GoodChat wordmark at left. Navigation 产品功能 使用场景 价格方案 接入帮助. 登录 and compact blue 免费开始 button at right. Fine neutral divider.
2. Hero is a WIDE PANORAMIC art-directed stage, not a two-column template. Upper-left/upper-center editorial headline, exact two-line text “连接每一位客户。” / “即刻回应每一次期待。” Make the first line ink and a few words on second cobalt. Strong purposeful typography. Beneath: “在线客服、团队协作与品牌页面，一处连接。” A small concise FREE OFFER badge reads “永久免费 · 2个客服坐席”. PrimaryCTA 免费创建工作空间 and low-emphasis 了解产品. Keep copy within comfortable measure.
The 3D silver conversation-loop occupies center-right/lower hero and sweeps across the composition with generous white/silver negative space. In FRONT along the lower hero, place one well-crafted readable SOFTWARE PANEL about850px wide that looks mounted into the stage, with header 客服工作台, a compact customer list of3 named contacts, a central conversation with two large readable messages and one compact profile field area. Do not shrink an entire dashboard into a tiny screenshot. Exact sample messages “你好，想了解一下你们的服务。” / “您好，很高兴为您解答。” Soft blue outgoing bubble, white incoming bubble, blue sendbutton. Place only two small context chips near the scene: 多入口接入 and 按规则分配. The sculpture and panel should work as one coherent visual rather than random floating cards. Avoid steep perspective that makes text hard to read. No heavy browser window chrome or laptop/phone bodies.
3. Next section on purewhite: small marker01 / CONNECT, left strong concise heading “接入很轻，协作很强。” right three short aligned rows, each with a small precise blue icon and ONE clear statement: “一个链接，连接网页与手机” / “按团队规则，分配给合适的人” / “用 AI 设计属于你的客服页面”. Use editorial row separators rather than cards. Include one understated miniature brand-page customization specimen at the lower edge, with realistic settings/preview but not a second full dashboard.
4. Compact light-silver FREE section with a precise typographic lockup “¥0” in ink, adjacent heading “从免费开始，让服务跟上增长。” Below exact supportingcopy “基础版长期免费，包含2个客服坐席。团队扩展时，再按需升级。” One compact blue 免费开始 CTA. Keep it light and restrained, no big blue background.
5. Footer wordmark GoodChat and 产品功能 / 价格方案 / 接入帮助 / 隐私政策 / 服务条款.
Quality bar: it should look like a thoughtfully art-directed high-end technology company official site, visibly different from the attached green proposal. Sharp typography, meaningful materiality, clear product details, intentional unequal spacing and strong hierarchy. NOT an undifferentiated white card grid. No code, no design-board annotations, one website only. Today is2026-10-28 if any date is needed; preferably only show10:24 in demo conversation.

prompts.name: 02-dashboard
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE realistic high-fidelity DESKTOP GoodChat SaaS product interface design, 1440 x 1000px landscape. This is a selected-style follow-on screen, not another homepage. The attached image is the user's APPROVED official website design and MUST anchor the blue/silver/white visual identity.
Translate that site's polished light technology design into practical DAILY-USE software: cool-white panels, very light silver/ice-blue work canvas, clean cobalt-blue #1455FF highlights, dark ink #111A2C readable text, delicate luminous silver edges and restrained soft layering. Restrained glass-like detail ONLY on chrome and panel edges; text and working surfaces must stay opaque and readable. No giant sculpture/ring or hero artwork occupying work space. Use no green, no purple, no blue-purple gradient, no dark sidebar or dark panels. No cartoon robots, fake AI customer replies, invented payment features, 3D controls, decorative sparkles, or irrelevant tech wallpaper.
Crisp 14–16px Simplified Chinese interface type, sensible 12px metadata, semibold28px titles, coherent 4/8px rhythm. Controls and tables should be compatible with Ant Design. 8px control radius and12px panel radius, consistent delicate edges and subtle shadows, strong hierarchy. Blue is used deliberately on selected navigation, primary actions, small status accents; not large saturated backgrounds. Actual useful software proportions, not an image of a laptop. Entire app screenshot fills canvas, no external browser window, no perspective tilt. Date anchor2026-10-28, demo times10:24. Mock data is for illustration only; tiny footer '界面设计示例'.
For normal management screens use216px expanded light sidebar with GoodChat cobalt mark+black wordmark, workspace selector 北岸工作空间, grouped navigation 工作空间 / 客服工作台 / 客户资料 / 聊天记录 / 服务统计 and 团队成员 / 接入链接 / 分组与分配 / 回复与运营 / 装修与模板 / 套餐与坐席 / 租户设置, bottomprofile.64px topbar with breadcrumb,help,avatar. Keep management chrome identical across management screens. For the agent workbench use a72px compact icon navigation to preserve conversation width.
Show only the requested screen and meaningful supporting controls. No fake world maps, fake sales charts or invented revenue metrics. No randomly repeated dashboards in one image. SCREEN: TENANT WORKSPACE OVERVIEW. Selected navigation 工作空间. Breadcrumb 工作空间 / 概览. Main title '你好，林可' and shortsubtitle '让每一次咨询，都有回应。' Right blueprimary 进入客服工作台.
Top compact row of FOUR actual product resource metrics: 团队成员2, 接入链接3, 客户档案28, 进行中咨询5, each clearly distinguished by type and weight rather than colorful decorative cards. Use white/ice panels and understated blue line icons, black tabular numbers.
Main focal area 2/3 left: one large beautiful white panel '接待准备' with four task rows '建立接待团队' / '配置分组与分配' / '创建咨询入口' / '设计品牌页面'. Each row has concise copy, completion/readiness status, and small 查看/去设置 action. A thin blue connector/check progression gives a specific communication-infrastructure signature, but no big illustration. Readable generous rows and clear hierarchy.
Right1/3 secondary panel '日常工作': four concise actionable rows 接待客户 / 邀请成员 / 查看聊天记录 / 装修品牌页面, with preciseblueicons and arrows. Below a small 当前套餐 免费版 /2个客服坐席 /长期有效 card with restrained thin usage bar1/2, 管理套餐 link. Bottom short onboarding tip '先跑通一次完整接待' and 查看接入指南 button.
Design character should be notably more polished and technological than a default Ant dashboard, through silver edges, proportion, cobalt selected state and confident typographic hierarchy, not through useless 3D rings. No sales/revenue/fake growthchart.

prompts.name: asset-rings
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / asset extraction. The attached approved GoodChat website is the exact art-direction source. Create a standalone high-quality raster production asset of ONLY its upper-right intertwined conversation-loop sculpture: polished silver metallic band, transparent clear-glass interlocking loop, luminous cobalt blue #1455FF inner rim, gentle ice-blue material reflections. Preserve the sculpture's silhouette, three-quarter front-view camera, physically believable silver/glass material and premium bright studio lighting from the reference. This asset is for layering BEHIND editable HTML hero text and product UI.
Output composition: landscape around1600x1100px, sculpture centered with generous transparent margin, object fully visible without cropping. Actual fully transparent background/alpha, including the empty holes in the loops. Subtle short contact shadow if appropriate, no opaque backdrop. NO text, NO logos, NO webpage, NO UI panels, NO buttons, NO people, NO floating labels, NO decorative icons, NO baseplate or floor. No green or purple. Do not reinvent the form into a globe or atom; faithfully recreate the specific intertwined silver/clear/cobalt loops in the attached design.
